Interface command

All Known Implementing Classes:
avatar, ban, clear, hello, help, kick, mute, ping, serverinfo, threads, unmute, userinfo
public interface command
Interface defining the contract for all bot commands. Every command implementation must implement this interface to be recognized by the bot. Provides default implementations for thread management and basic command execution.

  • Method Details

    • getName

      String getName()
      Returns the name of the command. This name is used to register the command with Discord.
      Returns:
      The command name as a string

    • getDescription

      String getDescription()
      Returns the description of the command. This description is shown to users in the Discord command interface.
      Returns:
      The command description as a string

    • getUsage

      String getUsage()
      Returns the usage instructions for the command. This should show how to use the command with its parameters.
      Returns:
      The usage string showing command syntax

    • getOptions

      default List<net.dv8tion.jda.api.interactions.commands.build.OptionData> getOptions()
      Returns the list of options/parameters for this command. Default implementation returns an empty list for commands with no parameters.
      Returns:
      List of OptionData objects defining command parameters

    • nombreDeThreads

      default int nombreDeThreads()
      Counts the current number of active threads in the application. Used for thread management to prevent excessive concurrent operations.
      Returns:
      The number of currently active threads

    • nombreDeThreadsMax

      default int nombreDeThreadsMax()
      Calculates the maximum number of threads allowed for the application. Based on available processors with a multiplier for optimal performance.
      Returns:
      The maximum allowed number of threads

    • execute

      default void execute(net.dv8tion.jda.api.events.interaction.command.SlashCommandInteractionEvent event)
      Executes the command when triggered by a user interaction. Default implementation provides thread management and basic error handling. Command implementations should override this method for specific functionality.
      Parameters:
      event - The slash command interaction event containing user input and context
